column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a # Handoff title with no stamp on line 3 is refused
a file of one newline is not the empty placeholder
a hand-written handoff is refused by the library
a resume on a broken binding stays as silent as before it was bound
a resumed session gets no banner
a stamp on a line other than 3 is refused
a stamp under a different title is refused
a stamp with no date is refused
a stamp with no full stop after the date is refused
and does not print that it wrote the handoff
and every byte is the one it had
and keeps all 212864 of its bytes
and leaves it as it was, byte for byte
and names --replace as the way through
and says how many bytes it would have destroyed
and writes the generated shape in its place
but not the session handoff, which a prior session wrote
felix handoff --replace overwrites it
felix handoff refuses a hand-written handoff
the SessionStart matcher binds resume
the refusal on stderr names the size in bytes
the session handoff is named as state to re-check by command
the write is renamed into place, not rewritten in it
with the note --was gave it
